source: Requested by the site owner on 2026-10-03 (sponsored posts, guest posts, and similar). The standards below are drafted to match the About page and the Privacy Policy and need owner approval.
heading: Partner With Fin Loom
subject: Partnership enquiry
intro: Fin Loom works with companies, agencies, and writers whose work is useful to readers who follow money, markets, and financial technology.
Every partnership is disclosed to readers, and none of them buys a conclusion.
options_intro: Four routes, each handled by email.

options.title: Sponsored Posts
options.text: Paid articles written by or with a sponsor. Each one is labeled as sponsored, names the sponsor, and is held to the same sourcing rules as our own research.

options.title: Guest Posts
options.text: Contributed articles from analysts, operators, and researchers with something specific to say. We look for original evidence or first-hand expertise, not general overviews.

options.title: Licensing and Syndication
options.text: Republishing Fin Loom research, charts, or data tables in your own publication or product, with attribution.

options.title: Other Partnerships
options.text: Research collaborations, data sharing, and ideas that do not fit the categories above. Tell us what you have in mind.

standards_intro: Readers come to Fin Loom for information they can check. Partner content has to meet that standard too.

standards.title: Disclosure
standards.text: Paid content is labeled as sponsored, and paid links are marked as sponsored.

standards.title: Evidence
standards.text: Claims need a source we can check. Statistics need a date and a definition.

standards.title: No Advice, No Promised Returns
standards.text: We do not publish recommendations to buy or sell, or content that promises or implies a return.

standards.title: Editorial Control
standards.text: Fin Loom may edit, decline, or remove partner content. Partners have no say over our own research.

start_copy: Send one email with the details below. We review relevant messages as soon as practical.
start_list: Who you are and the company or publication you represent
What you would like to publish or propose
Links to previous work or to the product involved
